scope: Major-moon generated assets only; simulation cross-OS identity is a separate contract.

horizons_satellite_elements.csv.identity: Committed JPL Horizons planetocentric ecliptic J2000 TDB element rows; content identity is the SHA-256, not the mutable service URL.
horizons_satellite_elements.csv.notice: Public-domain US government data; see moons/README.md.

horizons_satellite_vectors.csv.identity: Committed independent held-out JPL Horizons validation vectors; source bytes identified by SHA-256.
horizons_satellite_vectors.csv.notice: Public-domain US government data; see moons/README.md.

jpl_satellite_physical.csv.identity: Committed JPL SSD satellite GM, mean radius and mean density; source bytes identified by SHA-256.

serialization.ordering: JPL body code ascending; fixed field order
serialization.float_format: Pinned CPython built-in round and float/JSON serialization; generator source hash binds all representative-field formatting.

qualification.reason: Candidate amd64 manifest digest verified from primary Docker Hub metadata, but no matching local Linux x86_64 runtime/image was available. Windows ARM64 and WSL Linux aarch64 are diagnostic platforms, not canonical qualification.
